sources: https://www.bookyoursite.com/campgrounds/bill-frederick-park-and-pool-at-turkey-lake (now lands on a generic ReserveAmerica page)

values.note: City price list for the Family Camp Sites: partial hook-up $20, full hook-up $25, both including tax, per site per night. The park's entry fee ($5 per car daily) is listed separately; the page does not say whether campers pay it.

fees.source: https://www.orlando.gov/Parks-the-Environment/Directory/Bill-Frederick-Park-At-Turkey-Lake/Make-a-Reservation-in-Bill-Frederick-Park ('Full hook up $25, including tax per site'; 'Partial hook up $20, including tax per site'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.orlando.gov/Parks-the-Environment/Directory/Bill-Frederick-Park-At-Turkey-Lake/Make-a-Reservation-in-Bill-Frederick-Park ('Full hook up' sites) + RV site map PDF ('FULL HOOK UP SITES', 'PARTIAL HOOK UP SITES'), read 2026-10-21

sites.source: https://www.orlando.gov/files/sharedassets/public/v/1/departments/parks-amp-rec/bfp/rv-map-without-laundry-room.pdf ('*ALL SITES ARE BACK-IN ONLY'; 36 pads drawn, 37x10 to 65x20 ft, one area marked HOST SITE), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Booked online through the City of Orlando's WebTrac reservations portal (paid in full at booking) or at 407-246-4486. Guests of the Family Camp Sites may stay up to 45 days in a calendar year in total.

booking.source: https://www.orlando.gov/Parks-the-Environment/Directory/Bill-Frederick-Park-At-Turkey-Lake/Make-a-Reservation-in-Bill-Frederick-Park ('Book a reservation' -> florlandoweb.myvscloud.com WebTrac; 'Guests of the Family Camp Sites may stay for up to 45 days in a calendar year'; 'You will need to pay in full to secure your reservation'), read 2026-10-21

note: City of Orlando (Families, Parks and Recreation) campground at Turkey Lake; 10 full-hookup and ~25 electric/water sites, concrete back-in pads 37x10 up to 65x20 ft. Booking opens ~11 months out via the city portal. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on orlando.gov: $20 partial / $25 full hook-up (tax included), water and sewer at the full-hookup sites, all sites back-in, reservable online via the city's WebTrac portal, 45 days per calendar year limit. Not stated by the city: amperage, site count beyond the map's 36 pads, max rig length (45 ft left as derived), facilities, booking window. WebTrac search is behind Cloudflare and returned nothing.
flags: Website: the second link, https://www.bookyoursite.com/campgrounds/bill-frederick-park-and-pool-at-turkey-lake, is dead (it now lands on a generic ReserveAmerica home page). The city books through WebTrac: https://florlandoweb.myvscloud.com/webtrac/web/splash.html (reached from the orlando.gov 'Make a Reservation' page, which should stay as the website).
